Name: Jen's Storage Rooms (PIF)
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

A simple conversion of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6145]Storage Cabins[/url] mod to PIF. Comes in two varieties:

- A wide open room that upgrades alongside the Farmhouse
- Three different size rooms: Small, Medium, and Large that do not upgrade with the Farmhouse

Casks are enabled for each tier and size.
You may use multiple size rooms at the same time, however you wish.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].
- Copy [CP] [PIF] Jen's Storage Rooms into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
